responsibility: This file defines the NDS32 RTL pass that groups linker-relaxation candidates and annotates them with relax-group directives. Using dataflow and dominance information, it finds symbolic address materialization sequences such as sethi/lo_sum pairs, PIC and TLS access patterns, and certain floating load/store address uses, then inserts target-specific relax markers with unique group ids so the linker can later shrink them into gp-relative or other relaxed forms. It is the backend’s late machine-dependent preparation pass for NDS32 link-time relaxation.
